Name: Reset Terrain Features
Author: mabelSyrup
Description:
[size=3]Reset Terrain Features provides a way to clear, reset, and generate everything which spawns on a map.  Normally, changing maps mid-game results in bushes in cliffs, weeds in buildings, and trees floating in ponds.  With Reset Terrain Features, you can fix all that with a few clicks![/size]

By default, the key used to open the menu is L, but this is configurable with the config.json file found inside the mod folder.  Simply change the
[code][/code]﻿﻿[code]"MenuKey": "L" [/code] to whatever key is best for you!

If you enjoy my work and want to support me, [url=https://ko-fi.com/mabelsyrup]consider buying me a coffee[/url]!
